about.heading: About
about.body:
Jordan Kenchen is a lifestyle creator working across hospitality and travel, culinary and dining, and style and grooming.

Jordan's video content has earned more than 500K organic views across YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, reaching men and women aged 21–38 in Atlanta, Richmond / the DMV and Los Angeles.

Recent work includes a property tour at Nobu Hotel Atlanta, a chef feature and review at ML Steakhouse, and a dining vlog at Mastro's Steakhouse LA. Jordan is represented by Marquis Rogers of Full Circle Entertainment.
